hypothesis: A default stated in API documentation supports a narrower relation than arbitrary input substitution. Preserve the complete original test and remove one explicit scalar option that equals its documented default.
inputs: All17 source snapshots from the frozen uniform cohort. Use source tests, frontend resolution, repository Markdown and source receipts. Do not read candidate labels, previous test outcomes or prior proposed candidates.
language_scope: TypeScript in this prototype; other trials explicitly abstain and remain in the17 denominator.
authority: Exact class and method heading scope plus Option/Type/Default table; conflict across documentation files causes abstention.
construction: Omit one matching scalar property from a closed literal record.
If no fields remain and the sole parameter declares an empty object default, also propose omitting the argument.
Keep every other test statement and assertion unchanged.
ordering: Source retrieval rank, source path, call offset, field name, field omission before argument omission.
stop: First controlled failure per trial, followed by one independent exact-program repetition. Stop the trial even if repetition does not confirm.
native_controls: Each execution must pass all source controls and match the frozen emitted test syntax.
tests: 14 documented-default tests pass, including an executable implementation that violates the documented default, method scoping, conflicts, dynamic records, effectful fields and source consistency. Three import-route integration tests also pass.
development_context: This hypothesis follows the N10 default-mode finding in the completed round22 audit. Rules contain no task/repository/API names, expected defects or candidate IDs. All17 trials are development-seen.
limitations: Documentation can be incomplete or stale and does not override the issue.
Heading-based document-to-symbol binding is conservative but not a formal semantic proof.
Source control success does not alone establish all retained oracles. Independently audit every emitted alert.
Generation and selection are frozen before native execution; no post-audit replacement.
